name: Aristoles Calm
original_name: アリストレス・カーム
source:
Aristoles Calm is the Commander of the Helman Second Army, the largest unit of the military superpower created by the Helman Empire. A man from a noble family who was hailed as a prodigy from a young age, spending the majority of his childhood training to become a Commander within the army. Because of his reputation, few people look at him as a person, with the exception of Prince [url=/c52688]Patton Misnarge[/url] and his best friend Hubert Lipton, who were eager to have another boy their age to play with, from that moment on becoming inseparable friends.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Aristoles_Calm]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
